note: T2 capture, four runs on the OnePlus 6T. Geometry in dp (1 dp = 2.625 px) and the apps' own labels only. Run 1 2026-10-10 01:27-02:06: stopped early at Mnemo after a scripted multi-tap hit a reminder's inline Snooze (see _screens-sources/t2/notes.md). Run 2 2026-10-10 13:26-15:16 (daytime): one tap per command with a fresh screenshot before each, only own 'Sample alarm N' items touched, one test alarm at a time, each deleted after; lock screen not tested (phone kept unlocked). Run 2 covered the reminders of simplereminder, rereminder and medtimer, and org.fossify.clock's alarm. It stopped at 15:10 when another adb session took the phone's foreground. Not reached: cyclicalarms, Mnemo ringing, chronicle and equipoise item and calendar pages. Run 3 2026-10-10 18:23-18:46 (same rules): deleted the Fossify leftover 'Sample alarm 4'; cyclicalarms 1.6.2 blocks on a 'Permissions Required' screen (Display Over Other Apps, an Android Settings toggle) so nothing was captured; Mnemo 'Sample alarm M' rang 18:35 as a heads-up (captured, not tapped); chronicle item page captured via 'Sample toast T2' (deleted), chronicle has no calendar/day view; equipoise 0.5 has only Check in / Ledger / Settings, so no item page or calendar exists to capture. Not reached: none; not capturable: cyclicalarms ring, equipoise item/calendar. Run 4 2026-10-10 19:28-19:37, after the owner granted Cyclic Alarms 'Display over other apps' and dealt with MedTimer's battery card: cyclicalarms editor and ring captured ('Sample alarm 5' set 19:31, rang 19:33:00, dismissed 19:33:51, deleted 19:34:31); medtimer's Panoramica captured (it held only our own run-2 event). Run 5 2026-10-10 19:45-19:50: Fossify Clock ringing over the locked phone (full screen, slide knob); the phone was never unlocked.
